content: This Thai dataset includes many types of labeled data useful in sentence segmentation tasks. The raw text was generated by users having conversations in the financial domain and were acquired mainly by crawling social sites. The labeled data for sentence segmentation were manually annotated by linguists using the definitions in BIBREF21 .
